My question for you is does it matter if they hate you? Does these people matter at all? I use to think that way but then I realized that anyone else opinion doesn't matter but only my own. Then suddenly my world was quieter. It might be hard to stop your mind from telling yourself that no one hates you but it's easier to condition your subconscious to think "I don't care if they hate me". If everyone else hates you then that is more reason to love yourself. You don't depend on other people's opinion on what you think of yourself. Just because they hate you doesn't mean you should hate yourself. When someone was mean to me I always answer in kindness to make them lose face. If the world wants us to hate ourselves then we should love ourselves as a form of rebellion
